notes.title: MacOs Update, Boss Rng Removal
notes.content:
Unfortunately I had to disable the Steam addon for the MacOS version because it made the game unplayable. The consequences of this will be:

No achievements for Mac users
Mac updates may take longer to arrive

Other than that the experience remains the same.

About the boss:
Now the spheres do not spawn in random locations anymore. The spheres at the bottom will spawn where the lasers spawn (and the others will be on top). This gives you enough space to stand in the middle and figure out which way the laser will rotate.

notes.title: Candy World Optimization, Save System, Difficulty Nerfs
notes.content:
Candy World Optimization:
Optimized the candy corn blinking (resources loading efficiently and less times per second), cannon particles disabled with player distance, Loading resources for the cookie blink are now more optimized (+other minor stuff)

(The candy corn blinking are a great villain here because we have a lot of them in the stages)

Difficulty Nerfs:

 Desert Stage 1: The first triple jump challenge was nerfed because it was too hard for the moment of the game
 Candy World 2: In the last section of this stage (ballons+chocolate cubes+triple jumps) - More impulse in the baloons, added 2 more breakable blocks and now the portal platform is closer


Save System:
There was a bug where sometimes flies would not load correctly - Fixed

notes.title: Candy World Optimization (+some bonus)
notes.content:
Some users were experiencing optimization issues in the candy world that made the game unplayable. This emergency update aims to make the game at least playable until a definitive solution is applied.

Bonus adjustments:
- Candy Stage 1 - Difficulty balancing in some elements
- Moon stage 2 - Difficulty balancing in some elements
- Some boss rng adjustments
